_meta.description: Source registry for Phase 7B.5 serrurerie market research. Each source referenced by service evidence rows. No source may be added without complete metadata.

sources.methodology_summary: Editorial price guide from a Moroccan service marketplace. Provides per-intervention price ranges with day vs. night/weekend split. Explicit note that prices include labour and travel; parts always extra. Anti-scam section validates price floor. Urgency surcharge documented as 30–50% on day rates.
sources.parts_policy: PARTS_ALWAYS_EXTRA — explicitly stated: labour + travel included, parts billed separately
limitations: Single editorial source — no declared sample methodology
City commentary is descriptive, no per-city price table
Parts price ranges not always validated against hardware suppliers
Upper ceiling values may include complex scope
sources.duplication_risk: LOW — content is specific and not verbatim-copied elsewhere
sources.notes: Most comprehensive single Moroccan source found. Clear scope separation of labour vs. parts. Anti-scam price floors corroborate evidence from other sources. Night surcharge 30–50% is internally consistent.

sources.methodology_summary: Platform editorial with per-city summaries. States 'tarifs constatés sur le réseau' — implies transaction-derived data though sample size unknown. National guide page aggregates 6 city pages. Night surcharge 50–100% documented. Parts (cylinder vs. full lock mechanism) distinction explicit. Authorization doctrine (CIN check) explicitly present.
sources.parts_policy: PARTS_EXPLICIT — cylindre vs serrure complète distinction documented; cylinder change vs. full lock replacement explained
sources.urgency_semantics: NIGHT_22H_7H_SURCHARGE_50_100_PERCENT; weekend and holidays same surcharge
sources.authorization_doctrine: EXPLICIT — CIN, bail, facture d'eau required or gardien attestation; serrurier right and duty to verify occupancy
limitations: Same national platform as city pages — not fully independent across city subpages
Quoted as 'constatées' but no sample size disclosed
Marrakech blindée installation upper figure (12 000 MAD) significantly above national range — tourist market premium
Night surcharge range (50–100%) is wider than mano.ma (30–50%) — may reflect different artisan segments
sources.duplication_risk: LOW — original content, not duplicated from mano.ma
sources.notes: Second independent C+ source. Authorization doctrine explicitly documented. Night surcharge 50–100% vs mano.ma 30–50% — taking 50% as conservative anchor. Fès cheapest city; Rabat most expensive for standard opening.

sources.methodology_summary: City-specific page from same publisher as SRC_SERR_002. 'Tarifs recoupés avec les demandes réelles, revus chaque trimestre.' More granular on Casablanca-specific lock types (serrure à gorge in older medina/working-class neighbourhoods vs. cylindre européen in modern apartments). Vehicle locksmith data present. Serrurerie automobile pricing included.
sources.parts_policy: PARTS_EXPLICIT — cylinder part price stated separately (80–500 MAD) from labour+part combined (200–600 MAD)
limitations: Same publisher as SRC_SERR_002 — counted as Casablanca-specific supplement, not independent national source
Vehicle locksmith pricing for modern cars is a wide range (500–1500 MAD) — specialist vs. generalist gap
Tariffs 'recoupées' — implies some transaction basis but no sample size
sources.duplication_risk: SAME_PUBLISHER_SRC_SERR_002 — used as geographic supplement only
sources.notes: Good supplementary data for Casablanca and vehicle locksmith segment. Blind door installation range consistent with national page.

sources.methodology_summary: Advertised floor prices from a Casablanca locksmith platform. Minimum 'à partir de' prices. Not transaction-verified medians. Useful for floor calibration only.
sources.parts_policy: UNCLEAR — 'à partir de' prices, scope of parts inclusion not stated
limitations: Floor prices only — actual prices likely significantly higher
No scope clarity on parts inclusion
Single artisan platform — not representative of market
100 MAD serrure change likely parts-not-included or entry-level only
Possible bait pricing
sources.notes: D-grade. Useful only to confirm market floor exists. The 100 MAD floor for changement serrure is likely bare-minimum scenario or excludes parts. NOT to be used as a price anchor.

sources.methodology_summary: Specialist locksmith company website covering safe/vault opening. No explicit price disclosure — 'devis clair avant intervention' model. Confirms this service requires specialist knowledge, 24/7 availability, and confidentiality. No numerical data extractable.
limitations: No numerical prices disclosed
Service description only
Single company site
sources.notes: Confirms coffre fort is QUOTE_REQUIRED / DIAGNOSIS_FIRST. No price data extractable. Supports taxonomy decision to classify safe services separately.

sources.methodology_summary: Service listing confirming serrurerie automobile, coffre fort, digicode as standard services. No numerical prices stated — 'tarifs clairs' claimed. Confirms vehicle and safe segments are part of mainstream locksmith offer in Morocco.
limitations: No numerical data
Marketing content only
sources.notes: Confirms service taxonomy: vehicle, safe, digicode all part of locksmith scope in Morocco. No price data.

source_quality_summary.notes: No transaction-observatory or statistically verified data found for Moroccan locksmith market. Best available evidence is C+ editorial from established Moroccan platforms. Consistent cross-source corroboration of core price ranges across SRC_SERR_001 and SRC_SERR_002 increases confidence.
